discoveries.line: src/rules.mjs:66/69 still embeds raw values in C3 finding messages; the CLI now escapes at render, but any other consumer of checkPairs would get raw control bytes (rules scope owns it)

assumptions: Escape set is C0 0x00-0x1f, DEL 0x7f and C1 0x80-0x9f (U+009B is a single-byte CSI on some terminals); each rendered as the 4-char text \xNN, lowercase hex. Backslash itself is not escaped, so the rendering is not reversible - INV-05 only asks for no raw control bytes
Escaping is applied to each whole rendered line (path, key and message), so tabs inside a value now render as \x09; no existing spec line shows a tab in output
stderr messages (CliError and internal error) are escaped too, since paths and parseArgs flag text echo user input
